name: Shivagrico Implements Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1965, Shivagrico Implements Ltd deals in Rolling and Forging of agricultural 
implements and other products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SAIL manufactures and exports Agricultural Implements / Hand tools. Its product range includes Agricultural Implements and Hand
tools such as Pickaxes, Crowbars, Hoes, Pick 
& Cutter mattocks, Hammers, Mauls etc. The company also manufactures re-rolled products such as Angles, Flats, Rounds, Polygons, and Squares. The products are sold under the brands LION and CHETAK.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.5% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.49% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
